name: Analyze the retention of Spain customers across all quarters of 2010.
python_code:
# Filter for Spain customers and 2010 data
spain_2010 = df[(df['Country'] == 'Spain') & (df['InvoiceDate'].str.startswith('2010'))].copy()

# Drop rows with missing Customer ID
spain_2010 = spain_2010.dropna(subset=['Customer ID'])

# Extract quarter from InvoiceDate
spain_2010['Quarter'] = spain_2010['InvoiceDate'].str[5:7].astype(int).apply(lambda x: f'Q{(x-1)//3+1}')

# Get unique customers per quarter
quarterly_customers = spain_2010.groupby('Quarter')['Customer ID'].apply(lambda x: x.unique()).reset_index()
quarterly_customers.columns = ['Quarter', 'Customers']

# Calculate retention: customers who appear in consecutive quarters
quarters = sorted(quarterly_customers['Quarter'].unique())
retention_data = []

for i in range(len(quarters) - 1):
    current_q = quarters[i]
    next_q = quarters[i+1]
    current_customers = set(quarterly_customers[quarterly_customers['Quarter'] == current_q]['Customers'].iloc[0])
    next_customers = set(quarterly_customers[quarterly_customers['Quarter'] == next_q]['Customers'].iloc[0])
    
    retained = current_customers & next_customers
    retention_rate = len(retained) / len(current_customers) * 100 if len(current_customers) > 0 else 0
    
    retention_data.append({
        'From_Quarter': current_q,
        'To_Quarter': next_q,
        'Customers_Start': len(current_customers),
        'Customers_Retained': len(retained),
        'Retention_Rate_Pct': round(retention_rate, 2)
    })

result = pd.DataFrame(retention_data) if retention_data else None
